bug: Profile URLs from the API (polymarket_profile, hyperliquid_profile, myriad_profile, kalshi_profile, kalshi_url) went into href and window.open with no scheme check, so a javascript: or data: value would have been used as a link; 3 of the 4 window.open calls in the leaderboard table passed no noopener.
caught_by: independent code review, finding 1; confirmed by reading the 4 window.open calls and 6 href sites, and against the original (leaderboard-CSYA1tNl.js opens e.polymarket_profile, e.hyperliquid_profile and e.myriad_profile with window.open(s,"_blank") and no check)
fix: Added safeExternalUrl and openExternal in app/src/lib/safe-url.ts (http or https only; window.open always gets noopener,noreferrer) and profileLinks() in trader-profile/links.ts; every site uses them. safe-url.test.ts covers javascript:, data:, protocol-relative, relative and malformed input; links.test.ts asserts the hrefs for valid profiles are unchanged.

bug: The profile's X link returned any value starting with "http" as the href ("httpx://evil.example" and "https://evil.example/a" both passed), while the leaderboard used a strict builder.
caught_by: independent code review, finding 2; confirmed by reading links.ts:52 against filter-sort.ts:104-119 (the original's profile chunk has the same loose rule: Qe=e=>e.startsWith("http")?e:...)
fix: Moved the strict builder to app/src/lib/twitter.ts; filter-sort.ts and trader-profile/links.ts both re-export it, and the profile shows the X link only when it returns a URL. twitter.test.ts asserts both pages use the same function and lists the refused inputs.

bug: localStorage and sessionStorage were touched inside effects with no try (referral.ts:59,101-102,120 and theme-toggle.tsx:12). With storage blocked the access throws, and with no error boundary anywhere the whole app unmounted.
caught_by: independent code review, finding 6; confirmed by reading the effects and App.tsx (no boundary). The original has the same unguarded calls in index-IhZl9oLY.js and no boundary.
fix: Added app/src/lib/storage.ts (safeStore: a read answers null and a write is dropped when storage throws) and used it in both places; added components/error-boundary.tsx around the routes in App.tsx, cleared on route change. storage.test.ts and error-boundary.test.ts cover both; the 36 parity runs show the fallback does not appear.

bug: The share image fetch never looked at the response status or type, so an error body would be saved, copied or shared as a .png; download had no catch; the object URL was revoked on the line after click().
caught_by: independent code review, finding 8; confirmed by reading share-cards.tsx:10,24-30. The original (trader-profile-Dw7uEvrL.js, function Me) does the same and shows no failure message.
fix: Added trader-profile/share-image.ts: shareImage() rejects unless the response is ok and image/png, saveBlob() revokes the object URL after 10 s; download catches and saves nothing. share-image.test.ts covers 404, 500, a JSON body with 200, a network failure and the delayed revoke.

bug: The trader id from the route went into /api/trader/<id> and /api/kalshi/<id>/history unencoded, and ids from the API into /account/<id> hrefs unencoded, so an id holding / ? or # changed the path that was requested.
caught_by: independent code review, finding 11; confirmed by reading data.ts:71,108 and filter-sort.ts:123-125. The original does not encode /api/trader/${t} either, with no scenario depending on it: 0 of 576 captured wallets and usernames and 0 of 1,000 Kalshi usernames are changed by encodeURIComponent.
fix: encodeURIComponent on the id at each site (traderUrl, historyUrlFor, accountHref, the wallet lines and the Kalshi mark). data.test.ts asserts the scenario ids give byte-identical paths and that ../ ? # stay inside the segment.

bug: The leaderboard response was parsed with a schema over the whole list, so one trader with a field of the wrong type rejected all 576 rows and the query retried 3 times; the original has no schema (queryFn returns r.json()) and renders every row it can.
caught_by: independent code review, finding 7; confirmed by reading types.ts:20-43 against leaderboard-CSYA1tNl.js. The first-load failure display was checked and already matches the original ("0 of 0 traders", the yellow notice only under xe&&g).
fix: Rows are parsed one at a time (parseTraders): a wrong-typed optional field reads as absent, and a row is dropped only when stats.pnl is not a number; a body with no list gives an empty list. filter-sort.test.ts covers each case; the captured and live lists parse to 576 of 576 and 578 of 578 rows with 0 field differences.

bug: The profile's smart score schema required all 7 fields non-null and dropped the card if any one was null; the original prints score and tier as sent and computes the three percentages with arithmetic that takes a null ((null*100).toFixed(0) is "0").
caught_by: independent code review, finding 15; confirmed against trader-profile-Dw7uEvrL.js: r.smart_score.winRate*100, maxDrawdownPercent*100 and rSquared*100 accept null, while sharpeRatio.toFixed(2) and profitFactor.toFixed(2) throw on one.
fix: tier, score, winRate, maxDrawdownPercent and rSquared may be null and the card still shows (percent() in format.ts reproduces the arithmetic); sharpeRatio and profitFactor stay required, where the original throws. data.test.ts covers each field.
